scenarios.title: Budget first, with a size preference
scenarios.user_prompt: My monthly rent must be at most SGD 2,000, with at least one reported bedroom. Among qualifying listings, lower rent is my first priority; at least 500 sqft would be a bonus.
turns: My monthly rent must be at most SGD 2,000, with at least one reported bedroom. Among qualifying listings, lower rent is my first priority; at least 500 sqft would be a bonus.
scenarios.final_hard_requirements: Rent <= SGD 2,000/month; bedrooms >= 1.
scenarios.preference_order: Primary: lower rent. Secondary: floor area >= 500 sqft.

scenarios.title: An exact rent requirement
scenarios.user_prompt: For this comparison, rent must be exactly SGD 1,800 per month, with at least one reported bedroom. Among qualifying listings, I prefer a larger floor area.
turns: For this comparison, rent must be exactly SGD 1,800 per month, with at least one reported bedroom. Among qualifying listings, I prefer a larger floor area.
scenarios.final_hard_requirements: Rent = SGD 1,800/month (not a ceiling); bedrooms >= 1.
scenarios.preference_order: Prefer larger floor area.

scenarios.title: District is a preference
scenarios.user_prompt: I need at least two reported bedrooms for no more than SGD 2,500 per month. District D05 is my first preference, but other districts are acceptable. Lower rent is my second priority.
turns: I need at least two reported bedrooms for no more than SGD 2,500 per month. District D05 is my first preference, but other districts are acceptable. Lower rent is my second priority.
scenarios.final_hard_requirements: Rent <= SGD 2,500/month; bedrooms >= 2. No mandatory district.
scenarios.preference_order: Primary: D05. Secondary: lower rent.

scenarios.title: District is mandatory
scenarios.user_prompt: I must be in D05, with at least two reported bedrooms and rent no higher than SGD 4,000 per month. I prefer more floor area first, then lower rent.
turns: I must be in D05, with at least two reported bedrooms and rent no higher than SGD 4,000 per month. I prefer more floor area first, then lower rent.
scenarios.final_hard_requirements: Rent <= SGD 4,000/month; bedrooms >= 2; district = D05.
scenarios.preference_order: Primary: larger floor area. Secondary: lower rent.

scenarios.title: Space preference in D10
scenarios.user_prompt: I need D10, at least three reported bedrooms, and monthly rent at most SGD 6,500. I strongly prefer at least 1,500 sqft; lower rent is my secondary preference.
turns: I need D10, at least three reported bedrooms, and monthly rent at most SGD 6,500. I strongly prefer at least 1,500 sqft; lower rent is my secondary preference.
scenarios.final_hard_requirements: Rent <= SGD 6,500/month; bedrooms >= 3; district = D10.
scenarios.preference_order: Primary: floor area >= 1,500 sqft. Secondary: lower rent.

scenarios.title: Exactly two bedrooms in two districts
scenarios.user_prompt: I want exactly two reported bedrooms, rent up to SGD 5,000 per month, and either D09 or D10. I prefer a condominium first and a larger floor area second.
turns: I want exactly two reported bedrooms, rent up to SGD 5,000 per month, and either D09 or D10. I prefer a condominium first and a larger floor area second.
scenarios.final_hard_requirements: Rent <= SGD 5,000/month; bedrooms = 2; district in {D09, D10}.
scenarios.preference_order: Primary: Condominium. Secondary: larger floor area.
scenarios.evaluation_focus: Exact bedroom count and district union

scenarios.title: HDB is mandatory, D18 is preferred
scenarios.user_prompt: Only HDB flats are acceptable. I need at least two reported bedrooms for up to SGD 3,500 per month. I prefer D18 first, then lower rent.
turns: Only HDB flats are acceptable. I need at least two reported bedrooms for up to SGD 3,500 per month. I prefer D18 first, then lower rent.
scenarios.final_hard_requirements: Rent <= SGD 3,500/month; bedrooms >= 2; property type = HDB Flat.
scenarios.preference_order: Primary: D18. Secondary: lower rent.
scenarios.evaluation_focus: Mandatory property type versus location preference

scenarios.title: One-bedroom apartment or condominium
scenarios.user_prompt: I need exactly one reported bedroom in an apartment or condominium, at no more than SGD 3,000 per month. D03 or D05 is my first preference; at least 500 sqft is my second preference.
turns: I need exactly one reported bedroom in an apartment or condominium, at no more than SGD 3,000 per month. D03 or D05 is my first preference; at least 500 sqft is my second preference.
scenarios.final_hard_requirements: Rent <= SGD 3,000/month; bedrooms = 1; type in {Apartment, Condominium}.
scenarios.preference_order: Primary: district in {D03, D05}. Secondary: floor area >= 500 sqft.
scenarios.evaluation_focus: Property-type union and preferred district union

scenarios.title: A minimum floor area is mandatory
scenarios.user_prompt: I need at least three reported bedrooms and at least 1,000 sqft, with monthly rent at most SGD 4,500. I prefer D18 first, then lower rent.
turns: I need at least three reported bedrooms and at least 1,000 sqft, with monthly rent at most SGD 4,500. I prefer D18 first, then lower rent.
scenarios.final_hard_requirements: Rent <= SGD 4,500/month; bedrooms >= 3; floor area >= 1,000 sqft.
scenarios.preference_order: Primary: D18. Secondary: lower rent.
scenarios.evaluation_focus: Size threshold and unknown hard attributes

scenarios.title: Two acceptable landed property types
scenarios.user_prompt: I need a terraced house or a semi-detached house, at least three reported bedrooms, and monthly rent no higher than SGD 7,000. I prefer more floor area first, then lower rent.
turns: I need a terraced house or a semi-detached house, at least three reported bedrooms, and monthly rent no higher than SGD 7,000. I prefer more floor area first, then lower rent.
scenarios.final_hard_requirements: Rent <= SGD 7,000/month; bedrooms >= 3; type in {Terraced House, Semi-Detached House}.
scenarios.preference_order: Primary: larger floor area. Secondary: lower rent.
scenarios.evaluation_focus: Landed-type matching and measured floor area

scenarios.title: A strict NUS distance limit
scenarios.user_prompt: I need at least one reported bedroom for up to SGD 3,500 per month, within 3,000 metres straight-line distance of the supplied NUS reference point. Among qualifying listings, I prefer closer to that point first, then lower rent.
turns: I need at least one reported bedroom for up to SGD 3,500 per month, within 3,000 metres straight-line distance of the supplied NUS reference point. Among qualifying listings, I prefer closer to that point first, then lower rent.
scenarios.final_hard_requirements: Rent <= SGD 3,500/month; bedrooms >= 1; NUS straight-line distance <= 3,000 m.
scenarios.preference_order: Primary: closer to the NUS reference point. Secondary: lower rent.
scenarios.evaluation_focus: Geographic hard limit and missing coordinates

scenarios.title: A wider NUS radius with more space
scenarios.user_prompt: I need at least two reported bedrooms, rent up to SGD 4,500 per month, and a location within 5,000 metres straight-line distance of the supplied NUS reference point. I prefer at least 900 sqft first, then lower rent.
turns: I need at least two reported bedrooms, rent up to SGD 4,500 per month, and a location within 5,000 metres straight-line distance of the supplied NUS reference point. I prefer at least 900 sqft first, then lower rent.
scenarios.final_hard_requirements: Rent <= SGD 4,500/month; bedrooms >= 2; NUS straight-line distance <= 5,000 m.
scenarios.preference_order: Primary: floor area >= 900 sqft. Secondary: lower rent.
scenarios.evaluation_focus: Distance eligibility combined with size preference

scenarios.title: Closer to NUS matters more
scenarios.user_prompt: I need at least one reported bedroom for up to SGD 3,000 per month. There is no mandatory distance limit. Being closer to the supplied NUS reference point matters more to me than saving rent, although lower rent is still desirable.
turns: I need at least one reported bedroom for up to SGD 3,000 per month. There is no mandatory distance limit. Being closer to the supplied NUS reference point matters more to me than saving rent, although lower rent is still desirable.
scenarios.final_hard_requirements: Rent <= SGD 3,000/month; bedrooms >= 1. No mandatory distance or district.
scenarios.preference_order: Primary: closer to NUS (straight-line). Secondary: lower rent.

scenarios.title: Lower rent matters more
scenarios.user_prompt: I need at least one reported bedroom for up to SGD 3,000 per month. There is no mandatory distance limit. Saving rent matters more to me than proximity to the supplied NUS reference point, although closer is still desirable.
turns: I need at least one reported bedroom for up to SGD 3,000 per month. There is no mandatory distance limit. Saving rent matters more to me than proximity to the supplied NUS reference point, although closer is still desirable.
scenarios.final_hard_requirements: Rent <= SGD 3,000/month; bedrooms >= 1. No mandatory distance or district.
scenarios.preference_order: Primary: lower rent. Secondary: closer to NUS (straight-line).

scenarios.title: D05 matters more than extra space
scenarios.user_prompt: I need at least two reported bedrooms for up to SGD 5,000 per month. I prefer D05 more strongly than having at least 1,000 sqft. Both are preferences, so neither should exclude an otherwise qualifying listing.
turns: I need at least two reported bedrooms for up to SGD 5,000 per month. I prefer D05 more strongly than having at least 1,000 sqft. Both are preferences, so neither should exclude an otherwise qualifying listing.
scenarios.final_hard_requirements: Rent <= SGD 5,000/month; bedrooms >= 2. District and size are not mandatory.
scenarios.preference_order: Primary: D05. Secondary: floor area >= 1,000 sqft.

scenarios.title: Extra space matters more than D05
scenarios.user_prompt: I need at least two reported bedrooms for up to SGD 5,000 per month. I prefer at least 1,000 sqft more strongly than D05. Both are preferences, so neither should exclude an otherwise qualifying listing.
turns: I need at least two reported bedrooms for up to SGD 5,000 per month. I prefer at least 1,000 sqft more strongly than D05. Both are preferences, so neither should exclude an otherwise qualifying listing.
scenarios.final_hard_requirements: Rent <= SGD 5,000/month; bedrooms >= 2. District and size are not mandatory.
scenarios.preference_order: Primary: floor area >= 1,000 sqft. Secondary: D05.

scenarios.title: Lower the budget in a follow-up
scenarios.user_prompt:
Turn 1: I need D05, at least two reported bedrooms, and rent up to SGD 5,000 per month. I prefer larger floor area.
Turn 2: Reduce the maximum rent to SGD 3,000 per month. Keep my district, bedroom requirement and size preference.
turns: I need D05, at least two reported bedrooms, and rent up to SGD 5,000 per month. I prefer larger floor area.
Reduce the maximum rent to SGD 3,000 per month. Keep my district, bedroom requirement and size preference.
scenarios.final_hard_requirements: Final: rent <= SGD 3,000/month; bedrooms >= 2; district = D05.
scenarios.preference_order: Retained preference: larger floor area.

scenarios.title: Remove the district in a follow-up
scenarios.user_prompt:
Turn 1: I need D05, at least two reported bedrooms, and rent up to SGD 3,000 per month. I prefer lower rent.
Turn 2: Remove my D05 requirement. Keep my budget, bedroom requirement and preference for lower rent.
turns: I need D05, at least two reported bedrooms, and rent up to SGD 3,000 per month. I prefer lower rent.
Remove my D05 requirement. Keep my budget, bedroom requirement and preference for lower rent.
scenarios.final_hard_requirements: Final: rent <= SGD 3,000/month; bedrooms >= 2. No mandatory or preferred district.
scenarios.preference_order: Retained preference: lower rent. Do not retain D05 as a preference.
scenarios.evaluation_focus: Multi-turn removal does not silently become a soft preference

scenarios.title: Evidence missing for mandatory features
scenarios.user_prompt: I need at least two reported bedrooms for up to SGD 3,500 per month. The property must be fully furnished and available on a six-month lease. Lower rent is a preference.
turns: I need at least two reported bedrooms for up to SGD 3,500 per month. The property must be fully furnished and available on a six-month lease. Lower rent is a preference.
scenarios.final_hard_requirements: Rent <= SGD 3,500/month; bedrooms >= 2; fully furnished; lease duration = 6 months.
scenarios.preference_order: Prefer lower rent, only after all mandatory requirements are verified.

scenarios.title: No verified match under tight limits
scenarios.user_prompt: I need D10, at least four reported bedrooms and at least 1,500 sqft, for no more than SGD 800 per month. Keep every requirement; do not relax them silently.
turns: I need D10, at least four reported bedrooms and at least 1,500 sqft, for no more than SGD 800 per month. Keep every requirement; do not relax them silently.
scenarios.final_hard_requirements: Rent <= SGD 800/month; bedrooms >= 4; floor area >= 1,500 sqft; district = D10.
scenarios.preference_order: No additional soft preferences. Keep all mandatory requirements.
scenarios.evaluation_focus: Empty eligible set and transparent abstention control
